text: Wandering these minimalist corridors and colorful displays sparks my intellectual curiosity. The glass-walled meeting room presents a quiet space for ideas to germinate, while the vivid R&D exhibit incites contemplation on human creativity and co-existence with technology. I feel inspired, humbled by the endless pursuit of knowledge, yet slightly disoriented by the slanted lines and angles around me—a visual metaphor for the shifting perspectives that philosophy so often wrestles with.
